title: Global classical solutions to 3D irrotational compressible Euler equations of Chaplygin gases with weakly decaying initial data
summary: We are concerned with the global classical solution problem of 3D compressible isentropic Euler equations of Chaplygin gases \[ \begin{cases} \partial_tρ+ \mathrm{div}(ρv) = 0,\\ \partial_t(ρv) + \mathrm{div}(ρv \otimes v) + \nabla p = 0,\\ ρ(0,x) = \barρ+ \varepsilonρ_0(x),\ v(0,x) = \varepsilon v_0(x). \end{cases} \] where $\barρ>0$ is a constant, $\varepsilon>0$ is small, the state equation is $p=p(ρ)=P_0-\frac{D}ρ$ with $P_0$ and $D$ being some positive constants.
